name: job-watch
description: Live pane of long-running jobs (training, downloads, extractions): progress, ETA, stalls and finishes, read from their logs with no model calls.

stallMinutes.title: Stall after (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: A job whose log has not grown for this long is flagged as stalled (if its process is alive) or quiet.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often logs, processes and disks are re-read.

keepDoneMinutes.title: Keep finished jobs (minutes)
keepDoneMinutes.description: How long a finished job stays in the pane before it is dropped.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane when a job starts
autoOpen.description: Open the Jobs pane automatically the first time a long job is picked up.

disks.title: Disks to show
disks.description: Comma-separated mount points to show free space for. Empty shows / and everything under /Volumes.
